info.name: SYN-443 Barcode Returned-Mail API
info.description:
Returned Mail Barcode Cost Saving Enhancement (SYN-443).

**URL:** `POST https://api.localdev.acs529.com/api/v1/plans/unite/returnmail/{barcodeId}`

**Prerequisites (Suresh demo setup):**
1. `api.localdev.acs529.com` must resolve and have a listener on **443** (often localhost + local proxy)
2. Client cert `*.localdev.acs529.com` in Postman Settings → Certificates
3. Request body JSON from `returnmail-body.json`

See `docs/04-smoke-test-results.md` for connectivity notes.

request.description:
Suresh demo curl (PowerShell):

```
curl "https://api.localdev.acs529.com/api/v1/plans/unite/returnmail/UNT13649678458" `
  -H "Host: api.localdev.acs529.com" `
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" `
  --data-binary "@C:\temp\returnmail-body.json"
```

**Do not** put full URL in the `host` field — use `barcode.host` only.
